name: Ceremonial
description: Those who follow this career uphold the ancient traditions and honour of the Aslan race. Only Aslan of high standing are normally admitted to these hallowed halls.

poet.name: Poet
poet.description: You study and compose epic poetry and maintain the history of your clan.

clan_agent.name: Clan Agent
clan_agent.description: You enforce the will of your clan elders and investigate crimes.

priest.name: Priest
priest.description: You honour the ancestors, officiate at ceremonial occasions and arbitrate disputes.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: You commit a grievous breach of protocol and are Outcast. Drop your SOC to 2 and you must take the Outcast or Outlaw career next term.
mishaps.3: You are exiled because of some political scandal. Gain one of Survival 1, Pilot 1, Independence 1 or Streetwise 1.
mishaps.4: You are wounded in a duel. Roll Melee 8+; if you succeed, you won the duel and gain SOC +1.
mishaps.5: You are accused of a crime you did not commit. Roll Advocate 8+ to stay in the career.
mishaps.6: You are embroiled in a rivalry with another official, who ends your career. Gain them as a Rival.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: You uncover an embarrassing secret related to your clan or family. Either trade it for 1D Clan Shares or keep it in reserve. Whenever you use this secret, gain a clan elder as an Enemy.
events.4: You witnessed one of the great duellists in action. Gain Melee (Natural) 1, Athletics (Strength) 1, Carouse 1 or Medic 1.
events.5: You are assigned a challenging task. Roll Art, Investigate or Persuade 8+. If you succeed, gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. If you fail, you suffer DM-2 to your next advancement roll.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: Your clan prospers and so do you. Gain Carouse 1, Survival 1, Admin 1 or Independence 1.
events.9: You rise in influence in your clan. Gain TER +1 and any one skill.
events.10: You discover that one of your kinfolk has acted dishonourably. If you cover up their failing, gain them as an Ally. If you expose them, they challenge you. Roll Melee 8+ to defeat them. If they win, gain them as a Rival and SOC -2. If you win, gain them as an Enemy, but also gain TER +2.
events.11: You are trusted by the great lords of your clan. Gain TER +2, or gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: You excel in your role. You are automatically promoted.
